name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
usage: Large MoE, coding and long context

size_gb.note: The ISTA-DASLab and Unsloth GGUF builds include a 28.8 GB n-gram table that Strata reads from the SSD, not from memory (Strata MAC.md: GPU-mapped file 37.6 GB for Q2_0, 54.8 GB for IQ3_S, 82.6 GB for UD-Q4_K_XL).

formats.value: safetensors; GGUF and MLX builds by third parties
formats.note: ISTA-DASLab's GGUF repository declares Apache 2.0, unlike the Qwen Community License of the original; Unsloth's declares "other".

fits_128gb.note: with Strata: Q2_0 (≈ 46 GB needed), IQ3_S (≈ 63 GB, the default from 96 GB) and Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL (≈ 91 GB) stay resident, the n-gram table on the SSD; UD-Q5/Q6_K_XL stream experts from the SSD. Without Strata: ggml-org Q2_K (83.1 GB) fits; IQ4_NL (102 GB) and MLX 4-bit (111.5 GB) are tight

runtimes.value: Strata (MIT; engine built for this model; Metal engine on Apple silicon, also CUDA, HIP, Intel, Strix Halo, DGX Spark; OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible local API; image input); llama.cpp with GGUF; mlx-lm with mlx-community builds
runtimes.note: Strata's own measurements on an M5 Max 128 GB (macOS 27.2): decode about 95–102 tok/s with IQ3_S and 74–94 tok/s with UD-Q4_K_XL (MTP on), against 48–51 tok/s for llama.cpp Metal on the same packs; prompts about 1,150–1,300 tok/s. Strata 0.2.13, first released 24.09.2026; not independently verified.

provenance.value: consistent (ISTA-DASLab IQ3_S and unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL GGUF builds)
provenance.note: Metadata only. Uploaders: ISTA-DASLab (IST Austria lab; GSQ-RCO quantisation, repo created 07.09.2026, IQ3_S added 26.09.2026, about 7.0 M downloads) and unsloth (repo created 26.08.2026, Dynamic v3.1 quants of 04.11.2026, about 2.6 M downloads); both name Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next as base model. Parameter count in the GGUF metadata: 176.94 B for both, against 180.00 B in the official safetensors; the difference matches the 31 `mtp.*` tensors (multi-token prediction head), which these GGUFs do not include (Strata fetches them from the official checkpoint by HTTP range requests, checked against SHA-256). Files: GGUF, Markdown and text only (the unsloth repository also holds an `engram/set_split.py` helper). Licence: unsloth declares the Qwen Community License; ISTA-DASLab's card declares Apache 2.0, which does not match the original. Not done: comparing GGUF tensor headers, and the output check against the publisher's examples (step 7).

web.verdict: Most praised model on 128 GB Macs
web.summary: Praised on Hacker News; licence not Apache 2.0 or MIT.
web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026: Hacker News comments only, collected while researching other models.

comments.text: Used for more than a week with very good results: very fast, very long context windows, on an M5 Max 128 GB ([ttoinou, 02.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49939328)).
Settled on Qwen3.8 27B/Flash Next on a new M5 Max 128 GB Mac Studio ([fzxu22, 05.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50385925)).

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with Strata at about 70 tok/s on an RTX 5070 Ti with 64 GB of DDR4, Q3 quantisation; hard to tell apart from hosted models for coding ([mortalapeman, 06.11.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50400036)).
Strata looks promising for weight streaming, but inference crashed before finishing a full answer ([Balinares, 19.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50149101)).
